items.exampleEn: She put her phone aside and listened to me.
items.exampleZh: 她把手機放到一邊，專心聽我說。

items.exampleEn: We sat beneath a big tree to rest.
items.exampleZh: 我們坐在一棵大樹下休息。

items.exampleEn: It was merely a small mistake.
I have a question regarding my bill.
items.exampleZh: 我對我的帳單有一個疑問。

items.exampleEn: The hotel is cheap. Moreover, it is near the station.
items.exampleZh: 這間飯店很便宜，而且離車站很近。

items.exampleEn: Whenever I visit my aunt, she makes soup for me.
items.exampleZh: 每次我去看阿姨，她都會煮湯給我喝。

items.exampleEn: We flew to Seoul via Tokyo.
items.exampleZh: 我們經由東京飛到首爾。

items.sentenceEn: Please send me the file via email.
items.sentenceZh: 請用電子郵件把檔案寄給我。

items.audioEn: Whenever Helen feels stressed, she goes for a long walk beneath the trees.
items.audioZh: 每當 Helen 覺得有壓力時，她就會到樹下散步很久。
items.questionZh: Helen 有壓力時會做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: I would like to ask a question regarding the schedule.
items.sentenceZh: 我想問一個關於行程表的問題。

items.sentenceEn: This is merely the first step of our plan.
items.sentenceZh: 這只不過是我們計畫的第一步。

items.stemEn: The flat is large and bright. ____, the rent is quite low.
items.stemZh: 這間公寓又大又明亮，而且租金相當便宜。

items.stemEn: Please call me ____ you need help.
items.stemZh: 你需要幫忙的時候，隨時打電話給我。

items.passageEn: Helen works at a small travel company. Whenever customers have questions regarding their trips, they contact her via email or phone. Last week, a man was angry because his flight was late. It was merely a short delay, but he was very worried. Helen put her other work aside and helped him find a new flight. Moreover, she gave him a free meal ticket. Surely he will book with them again.
items.passageZh: Helen 在一間小旅行社工作。每當客人對行程有疑問時，都會透過電子郵件或電話聯絡她。上週，一位先生因為班機延誤而很生氣。那只是短暫的延誤，但他非常擔心。Helen 把其他工作放到一邊，幫他找到新的班機。此外，她還送他一張免費餐券。他一定會再找這間公司訂行程。

questions.questionZh: Helen 除了幫他換班機，還做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 每當我去台北，我都住在同一間飯店。
referenceEn: Whenever I go to Taipei, I stay at the same hotel.
I stay at the same hotel whenever I go to Taipei.
rubricZh: 習慣性的事用現在簡單式
the same hotel 表示「同一間飯店」

items.instructionZh: 用 moreover 造兩個句子，說明你喜歡某個地方的兩個理由。
referenceEn: This cafe is quiet. Moreover, the coffee is cheap.
The park is quiet. Moreover, it is close to my home.
rubricZh: moreover 用來補充另一個理由
通常放在第二句句首，後面加逗號
前後兩句的意思方向一致

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 前句 I like this cafe. 只是表態、不是理由，整組只給出一個理由，不符題目「兩個理由」的要求；moreover 接在非理由句之後補充理由，用法不道地
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改為 "This cafe is quiet. Moreover, the coffee is cheap."（兩句都是理由，moreover 補充第二個理由）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第③關裁示修正："use the company again" 不道地
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Helen works at a small travel company. Whenever customers have questions regarding their trips, they contact her via email or phone. Last week, a man was angry because his flight was late. It was merely a short delay, but he was very worried. Helen put her other work aside and helped him find a new flight. Moreover, she gave him a free meal ticket. Surely he will book with them again."（原 "Helen works at a small travel company. Whenever customers have questions regarding their trips, they contact her via email or phone. Last week, a man was angry because his flight was late. It was merely a short delay, but he was very worried. Helen put her other work aside and helped him find a new flight. Moreover, she gave him a free meal ticket. Surely he will use the company again."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 正解「Moreover」由位置 0 移到 1，與「Merely」互換；審題員判題索引同步重對應
